body: Day shift handover: column casting for grid C done, curing started. 18 labour present.
Waterproofing of terrace completed as planned. Photos shared with client.
All material stacked properly, site cleaned before closing. Good night team
Worker slipped from scaffolding at Block D, minor leg injury, taken to hospital
Water tanker didn't come and the curing has stopped since morning
Someone stole 3 copper cable rolls from the store last night. Lock was broken.
Crane operator hasn't reported for 2 days, all lifting work on hold. What should we do?
Architect sent revised drawing, kitchen window moves 2 ft left. Please redo the lintel marking.
Please postpone Saturday's slab pour to next Wednesday, pump not available
From next week site timings will be 8 to 5 instead of 9 to 6, please inform labour
Only 6 bags of white cement left, need 30 more by Friday
JCB will be available at our site from tomorrow for 3 days
Paint delivery received: 40 litres primer, 60 litres emulsion
Is the vendor payment for the tiles cleared?
Rebar spacing for the staircase slab 150 or 200 mm?
Meeting tomorrow is at site office or head office?
Forwarded: 10 tips to stay healthy during monsoon
Thanks everyone for the hard work 🙏
Mixer machine motor burnt, concreting aagipoyindi. Mechanic ni pampinchandi
